newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
WASHINGTON, May 30 (Reuter) - Soybean export sales reported during the latest week:

Net sales of 145,900 MT fell 48 percent below the previous week and 44 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for China (70,300 MT), Mexico (52,300 MT), and South Korea (21,500 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (125,000 MT, including 55,000 MT switched to 1997/98).
Sales of 345,600 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for unknown destinations (321,000 MT).

Exports of 356,800 MT exceeded the previous week by nearly three-quarters and the 4-week average by one-tenth. The primary destinations were Japan (80,800 MT), China (70,300 MT), Mexico (68,800 MT), and South Korea (36,500 MT).
